background: Bank of Montreal is one of Canada's big six banks and the country's oldest, with a large US Midwest franchise through BMO Harris and the former Bank of the West, funded by Canadian and US deposits.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook; the last move was a three-notch downgrade by one of the three on 26 Jan 2026. Capital is the weak side of Canadian banks, with CET1 of 13.0% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 4.2% below the peer median. CET1 has fallen 0.5 points since 31 Jul 2025, while leverage has held flat. The site holds no liquidity ratios for the bank, so the view rests on capital and ratings.
